definition.title: Gate buyer-trust evidence deterministically
definition.description: Validate pasted header and status evidence for a public site and checkout with ordinary Python. No fetching, no model calls, no credentials. Returns a PASS/FAIL gate with ranked fixes.

headers_json.title: Observed headers as JSON
headers_json.description: JSON object with optional string keys: hsts, csp, x_frame_options, referrer_policy, x_content_type_options, security_txt_contact, security_txt_expiry.

checks_json.title: Observed status codes as JSON
checks_json.description: JSON object with integer status codes: privacy_status, security_txt_status, robots_status, git_head_status, env_status.

checkout_json.title: Checkout facts as JSON
checkout_json.description: Optional JSON object: guest_option and total_before_pay booleans, contact_url and refund_url strings.
